facts.fact: Sienna 的终极揭露：Reunion Killer 就是 Max 自己——她从手稿（Dead Girls Don't Lie）里读出了全部犯罪经过。
facts.anchor: You killed them, Max. All of them. And it started with Jordan.

facts.fact: Jordan 死因：她半夜抱怨噪音、Max 假装道歉让她开门，在阳台推了她——「解离记忆」中她听到了尖叫。
Sydney 死因：Max 把 minibus 花生碾成粉末掺进 Sydney 饮料（她没吃所以是 easiest way）、藏起带 EpiPen 的手包在门厅篮子里。
facts.anchor: you crushed the packets of peanuts

facts.fact: Brooke 死因：Max 偷主钥匙进房、把浴缸里的 Brooke 头按进水中溺死、用剃刀割腕伪装自杀——「fate would have it, happened to be right next to yours」。
facts.anchor: held her head beneath the water

facts.fact: Amber 死因：Amber 说她知道 Max 杀了 Brooke「不会放过你」——Max 开车把她压在树上，「I did take joy in it. I savored every gasp.」
facts.anchor: She said something to trigger you

facts.fact: Delaney 死因：篝火之争后 Delaney 背身，Max 用石头击打+树上的绳套吊死她——「she was fighting for her life. But you just stood there, watching her struggle」。
facts.anchor: you picked up a rock and struck her

facts.fact: Misty 死因：Max 知道她每晨跑步路线、在湖边等她，从背后击倒、按入水中溺死。
facts.anchor: You struck her from behind and knocked her into the water.

facts.fact: Kayla 不死的原因：她已经自己毁了自己——「Why bother ending her life when she's doing such a good job of ruining it on her own?」
facts.anchor: You didn’t kill Kayla because you didn’t have to.

facts.fact: Peyton 是最后一个目标——Max 用 Crashing Echoes 中写的可燃化学品（黑市买、PA FedEx 寄来）处理了她的啦啦队服，用烟头点燃。
facts.anchor: was supposed to die tonight, too,

facts.fact: Sienna 的揭露方式：她撬开 Max 房间读了手稿——「你改了名字，但其余都在白纸上：谋杀、只有调查人员才该知道的细节」。
facts.anchor: A confession disguised as a manuscript.

facts.fact: 结局：Sienna 亲手给 Max 戴手铐——「I hate that I'm the one who has to do this to you」/「I'm glad it's you」。
facts.anchor: Maxine Morgan, you’re under arrest for murder.

facts.fact: 探监对话：Sienna 问「报复爽吗」——Max 承认有过快感但现在只剩 guilt and sadness；Sienna 说「not regret」——Max 没否认。
Sienna 的辩护：Reds 教会你恨自己——「if you want me to feel sorry for them, I don't. I believe in justice. In my eyes, you carried out that justice.」
facts.anchor: They spent years making you believe there was something wrong with you.

facts.fact: Sienna 的立场：你们不会为他们掉一滴泪——只有你值得我同情；「the rest of the world can go fuck itself」。
facts.anchor: The only person standing in this jail who deserves my sympathy is you.

facts.fact: 最终判词：Reds 教会 Max 的恨不是恨别人——是恨自己。
facts.anchor: And you know what the saddest part in all of this is? The Reds taught you how to hate, too. Not other people. Yourself.

facts.fact: 章尾悬念：Max 问「你明知我要杀 Peyton 为什么不阻止我」——Sienna 沉默后微笑（不回答，留给读者/结局）。
